parsed.explanation: State-directed targeting dominates: 2024 law classifies depictions/trans presence as pornography (up to 4 years' imprisonment) and 2026 propaganda ban covers gender reassignment, with immediate enforcement. Police detained 15+ LGBTQ+ people in September 2024 alone, 8 trans, on hooliganism/pornography charges, with reported beatings, coerced charges and custody abuse; police collect passport/photograph data and have raided venues, with foreigners threatened with expulsion for attending events. No anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection, police do not investigate anti-LGBT violence, prisons enable blackmail and staff-encouraged abuse, and state media frames trans identity as paedophilia/foreign threat amid 84% public hostility. This is tier-2 organised state coercion with severe penalties and no recourse, below a mere hostile society but without documented near-certain execution.
